When a person dies, the heart you had entrusted to that person dies also.

A part of the heart dies, and a hole opens.
Something warm goes, and something empty is born in its place.

...The emptiness that Mizuhi's death made was bigger and deeper than I could have imagined, until it came.

Between this person and me.

And still.
I had left such a large part of my heart with her.

I learned it only after losing her.
...Learned that perhaps I had lost someone I must never have lost.

That perhaps this person had been necessary to me, to a man like me—

統"Yes..."

統"...What did you just say?"

Hikaru"You showed them false martial power, Mother. You made them believe that one may fight, lose, and still not be killed・・・・・・・."
統"............"

統"You..."

統"Don't come any closer. Step back, right where you are, and get out!"

— I can stop her.
Subaru was certain of it.

She knew her daughter's ability.
Plainly speakingplainly, Hikaru was a talent bordering on the demonic.

A year ago, just before the illness struck her down, the technique had been close to complete.
But... it had still left openings Subaru could get into.

A year had passed since. Hikaru's art had stalled.
No — by common sense it should have gone backward. Though on that point, it seemed unwise to expect much from common sense.

With Hikaru's flowing stance, 'just risen from a sickbed' sounded like a poor jokejoke.
Still — Subaru judged she could hold her.

The variety, sharpness and strength of the techniques showing in that stancestance fitted inside what Subaru could handle.
A dangerous margin, yes. But one sheet of paper is enough to win by, na.

Subaru Minato had her own pride in her technique.
With another six months — no, even three — of Hikaru's training, it might have been unclear. At this stage, she still judged herself ahead.

— Behind KaranKaran, mate in eight moves.

She drew the picture of victory in her head.
Rechecked it. ...Nothing in the calculation could break it.

Then execute. Subaru tilted her center of gravity forward and waited for the moment to move.◆

There, the calculation collapsed.

　一年前、病に倒れる直前、その技術はもう完成まで

　あれから一年。光の技は停滞している。
　いや、後退しているはずだ――常識的に考えれば。
それについてはどうもあまり期待しない方が良さそう

　光の流麗な立ち姿は、これで病み上がりなどと言わ
れてもつまらぬ諧謔ギャグにしか思えない。
　しかし――まだ、抑え切れる。統はそう踏んだ。

　構かまえから窺える技の多様さ、鋭さ、強靭さは統の許容
量に収まる。
　危うい線ではあっても、紙一枚の差で勝てる。

　湊斗統にも己の術技に自負するところがあった。
　あと半年――いや三ヶ月も光が修練を重ねていたら
わからなかったろうが、現段階ではまだ優ると見た。

　――花乱カランの裏から、八手で詰み。

　脳裏に勝利への図式を思い描く。
　推敲。……この計算を崩す要素は無い。

　ならば図式を実行する。
　統は重心を前へ傾け、仕掛ける気を窺った。◆
　
　そこで、計算は崩壊した。
